title: This MR enable using the RISC-V advanced package architecture (AIA) on KVM.
description:
This MR enable using the RISC-V advanced package architecture (AIA) on KVM.

Instead of backporting a numerous patches the number of interrupt lines is limited to 63 which is the guaranteed minimum and which matches available hardware.

A further patch is added to avoid undefined behavior when reading the AIA configuration.

+From 840406c541d4c75fcd11eb563889eb22a792f36f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Heinrich Schuchardt <heinrich.schuchardt@canonical.com>
+Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:40:42 +0000
+Subject: [PATCH 1/1] hw/riscv/virt: Reduce the number of aia interrupts
+
+Currently running QEMU with KVM on RISC-V hardware fails with an error
+
+    qemu-system-riscv64: KVM AIA: failed to set number of input irq lines
+
+The guaranteed number of interrupts for the RISC-V advanced interrupt
+architecture is 63.
+
+Instead of backporting all the patches needed to actually measure the
+number of available interrupts just assume the guaranteed minimum.
+
+Link: https://lore.kernel.org/all/20260928-spacemit-k3-v1-0-8c57d0596b87@butz.st/
+Signed-off-by: Heinrich Schuchardt <heinrich.schuchardt@canonical.com>
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/qemu/+bug/2174362
+Forwarded: no, upstream is working to a full solution
+---
+ include/hw/riscv/virt.h | 8 ++++----
+ 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/include/hw/riscv/virt.h b/include/hw/riscv/virt.h
+index 18a2a323a3..8cce710802 100644
+--- a/include/hw/riscv/virt.h
++++ b/include/hw/riscv/virt.h
+@@ -97,13 +97,13 @@ enum {
+     VIRTIO_COUNT = 8,
+     PCIE_IRQ = 0x20, /* 32 to 35 */
+     IOMMU_SYS_IRQ = 0x24, /* 36-39 */
+-    VIRT_PLATFORM_BUS_IRQ = 64, /* 64 to 95 */
++    VIRT_PLATFORM_BUS_IRQ = 0x2e, /* 40 to 63 */
+ };
+ 
+-#define VIRT_PLATFORM_BUS_NUM_IRQS 32
++#define VIRT_PLATFORM_BUS_NUM_IRQS 16
+ 
+-#define VIRT_IRQCHIP_NUM_MSIS 255
+-#define VIRT_IRQCHIP_NUM_SOURCES 96
++#define VIRT_IRQCHIP_NUM_MSIS 63
++#define VIRT_IRQCHIP_NUM_SOURCES 63
+ #define VIRT_IRQCHIP_NUM_PRIO_BITS 3
+ #define VIRT_IRQCHIP_MAX_GUESTS_BITS 3
+ #define VIRT_IRQCHIP_MAX_GUESTS ((1U << VIRT_IRQCHIP_MAX_GUESTS_BITS) - 1U)
+-- 
+2.55.0
+
diff --git a/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2174362/target-riscv-kvm-aia-mode-is-an-uint32_t.patch b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2174362/target-riscv-kvm-aia-mode-is-an-uint32_t.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..dfd5ff8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2174362/target-riscv-kvm-aia-mode-is-an-uint32_t.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+From: Heinrich Schuchardt <heinrich.schuchardt@canonical.com>
+Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:19:32 +0000
+Subject: [PATCH 1/1] target/riscv/kvm: aia mode is an uint32_t
+
+In Linux' struct kvm_aia the field mode is defined as u32.
+Calling kvm_device_access() only copies these 32bits to the first four
+bytes indicated by the address passed.
+
+Trying to read the mode into uint64_t default_aia_mode will only initialize
+the leading four bytes and leave the rest of the variable as a random value
+from the stack.
+
+* Change the definition of aia_mode and default_aia_mode to match the
+  variable type in the kernel.
+* Adjust the signature of kvm_aia_mode_str().
+
+Signed-off-by: Heinrich Schuchardt <heinrich.schuchardt@canonical.com>
+Forwarded: yes, https://lore.kernel.org/qemu-riscv/20261116135102.32508-1-heinrich.schuchardt@canonical.com/T/#u
+---
+ target/riscv/kvm/kvm-cpu.c | 6 +++---
+ 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/target/riscv/kvm/kvm-cpu.c b/target/riscv/kvm/kvm-cpu.c
+index 5beb602338..b92f961979 100644
+--- a/target/riscv/kvm/kvm-cpu.c
++++ b/target/riscv/kvm/kvm-cpu.c
+@@ -1884,9 +1884,9 @@ void kvm_riscv_set_irq(RISCVCPU *cpu, int irq, int level)
+     }
+ }
+ 
+-static int aia_mode;
++static uint32_t aia_mode;
+ 
+-static const char *kvm_aia_mode_str(uint64_t mode)
++static const char *kvm_aia_mode_str(uint32_t mode)
+ {
+     switch (mode) {
+     case KVM_DEV_RISCV_AIA_MODE_EMUL:
+@@ -1937,7 +1937,7 @@ void kvm_riscv_aia_create(MachineState *machine, uint64_t group_shift,
+ {
+     int ret, i;
+     int aia_fd = -1;
+-    uint64_t default_aia_mode;
++    uint32_t default_aia_mode;
+     uint64_t socket_count = riscv_socket_count(machine);
+     uint64_t max_hart_per_socket = 0;
+     uint64_t socket, base_hart, hart_count, socket_imsic_base, imsic_addr;
+-- 
+2.55.0
+
